names.legendary: Grizwold, the Long Yawn

lore.common: Breaks into the picnic basket, eats every sandwich and politely leaves the napkins folded.
lore.uncommon: Gives hugs so warm that campers forget they are sleeping in the snow.
lore.rare: Can smell honey through two locked doors and a bank vault. The bees have hired a lawyer.
lore.epic: Shook one tree so hard that every pinecone in the forest fell at once. The squirrels now wear helmets.
lore.legendary: Hibernated so deeply that it slept through an entire century. Woke up, yawned and asked if lunch was ready.

names.legendary: Koalathra, Keeper of the Twenty Hours

lore.common: Clings to a table leg and refuses to admit it is not a eucalyptus tree.
lore.uncommon: Sleeps through breakfast, lunch and the question of what it wants for dinner.
lore.rare: Its eucalyptus breath calms the noisiest room. The village brass band has started practising outside.
lore.epic: Hugged an entire grove of gum trees into a peaceful slumber. Even the parrots whispered and the chainsaws quietly went home.
lore.legendary: Koalathra dreams of every forest that ever grew under the southern stars. When one is threatened, it awakens for a single hour and makes the trees walk away to safety.

names.legendary: Wombella, Queen of the Second Door

lore.common: Leaves neat little cube-shaped surprises beside the garden path.
lore.uncommon: Digs a tunnel under the fence, then insists the gate was always unnecessary.
lore.rare: Plugs a collapsing burrow with its armoured bottom and sends the foxes bouncing home.
lore.epic: Duchess Dirtquake dug beneath the town hall and installed an underground ballroom before the council noticed. The mayor now attends meetings by slide.
lore.legendary: Wombella carved a second doorway through the mountain when winter sealed the only pass. Travellers leave carrots beside her stone tunnel, though nobody has seen her since the first thaw.

names.legendary: Vespera, Empress of the Unseen Night

lore.common: Sleeps upside down and criticises everyone who insists on standing properly.
lore.uncommon: Finds lost keys by shouting at the sofa. The sofa has asked for a quieter tenant.
lore.rare: Can navigate a pitch-black maze while reciting every embarrassing conversation heard inside it.
lore.epic: Gathered a million wings over the city and turned midnight into a moving velvet ceiling. Every moth declared an emergency.
lore.legendary: Before the stars were named, Vespera charted the darkness by sound alone. Her echoes still guide wanderers through caves that have no entrance.

names.legendary: Alpacalypse, Lord of the Woolstorm

lore.common: Looks like a cloud with opinions. Spits at anyone who mistakes it for a llama.
lore.uncommon: Hums lullabies in the pasture and refuses to explain why the sheep keep falling asleep standing up.
lore.rare: Its fleece builds so much static that entire socks migrate toward it. The laundrette has issued a missing-person notice.
lore.epic: Shook off its winter coat and buried a mountain village in wool. The rescue team emerged three days later wearing matching jumpers.
lore.legendary: Alpacalypse shears the storm clouds themselves and spins their thunder into silver fleece. Once a century it descends to judge humanity's knitwear.

names.legendary: Dromedor, Last Caravan of the Sunken Sea

lore.common: Chews with its mouth open while making uninterrupted eye contact. Nobody has won this contest.
lore.uncommon: Gives tourists a complimentary shower of spit whenever they mention how cute its hump is.
lore.rare: Stores an entire campsite inside its hump, including the tents, snacks and somebody's missing uncle.
lore.epic: Walked across the desert so stubbornly that the dunes moved out of its way. The new road is named after its bad attitude.
lore.legendary: Dromedor walks the routes of vanished oceans, carrying a caravan of ghosts and very real luggage. It has never asked for water, only a review on TripAdvisor.

names.legendary: Lady Llamara, Judge of the Mountain

lore.common: Will carry one sock up a hill, provided someone carries the other one for it.
lore.uncommon: Gives such a devastating sideways glance that even the goats reconsider their manners.
lore.rare: Spits precisely into the boots of anyone who calls it a sheep. The boots are now displayed as a warning.
lore.epic: Led the entire mountain caravan on strike until every pack animal received a lunch break and a better view.
lore.legendary: Lady Llamara passed judgement on a hundred raiding foxes without making a sound. Her stare turned them into harmless tufts of wool, which she promptly knitted into a scarf.

names.legendary: Minkerton, the Thief Between Locks

lore.common: Steals the warmest sleeping bag at camp and sleeps with one suspiciously luxurious paw sticking out.
lore.uncommon: Glides through a stream as smoothly as poured ink. The fish now accuse the water of harbouring spies.
lore.rare: Escapes cages through gaps no bigger than a coin, then leaves the coin behind as payment.
lore.epic: Emptied every fishing boat along the harbour without so much as a splash. The fishermen blamed a sea monster wearing an expensive coat.
lore.legendary: Minkerton slipped from a locked chest inside a locked vault beneath a locked castle. At dawn, the king found his crown floating downstream with a note saying TOO SHINY.

names.legendary: Duchess Mustela of the Midnight Burrow

lore.common: Sneaks into the clean laundry and gives everything a rather personal perfume.
lore.uncommon: Bounces across the grass in a wild dance whenever it finds a particularly promising mouse hole.
lore.rare: Releases a cloud of musk so potent that the guard dogs forget which way they were patrolling.
lore.epic: Raided the entire henhouse under cover of an enormous foul-smelling fog. The chickens relocated to the church bell tower.
lore.legendary: Duchess Mustela stole a golden egg from the fox king's fortress and carried it through a hundred guarded tunnels. She returned it to the nesting bird, then stole the fox king's slippers for good measure.

names.legendary: Bessith, Matriarch of the Moonswept Herd

lore.common: Moos under the bedroom window at dawn, then pretends the sound came from a tractor.
lore.uncommon: Chews one mouthful for six hours. Calls this fine dining.
lore.rare: Runs so bumpily that its milk comes out as a milkshake. The farmer has opened a cafe.
lore.epic: Its bellow rang every bell across three valleys. The villagers celebrated; the local church accused it of stealing Sunday.
lore.legendary: The first cow to leap across the moon was Bessith. She returned with silver grass on her hooves and refused to explain why the moon now has hoofprints.

names.legendary: Cervalune, Stag of the Silver Crossing

lore.common: Eats your favourite tulips, then gazes at you as though you planted dessert.
lore.uncommon: Hops a garden fence with the elegance of a ballet dancer escaping a parking fine.
lore.rare: Can make traffic stop simply by looking at the road. The traffic lights consider it a rival.
lore.epic: Its antlers grew across the valley like living branches. The entire forest's migrating birds perched there to rest.
lore.legendary: On moonless nights Cervalune carries the forest's lost paths between its antlers. Follow its silver footprints, and even a forgotten traveller can find home.

names.legendary: Sir Affenwhisker, Terror of Titans

lore.common: Has the face of a grumpy old man and uses it to win every staring contest.
lore.uncommon: Climbs onto the kitchen table like a monkey whenever it hears a crisp packet open.
lore.rare: Once captained a pirate ship by barking at the compass. Its crew found three islands and a deeply annoyed lighthouse keeper.
lore.epic: Declared itself supreme enemy of the city's rats. By sunset even the stone rat statues had moved away.
lore.legendary: Giants surrender when it bares its tiny teeth. Nobody has had the heart to explain that the fearless conqueror weighs four kilos.

names.legendary: Lady Silkenpaws, Empress of the Gale

lore.common: Spends an hour on its hair every morning and still turns up late for the walk.
lore.uncommon: Its fur arrives a full second after it does. It calls this a dramatic entrance.
lore.rare: One graceful hair toss mesmerises every witness. Several professional dog judges have never recovered.
lore.epic: A single magnificent hair flip unleashed a storm that stole every wig in the royal court. The king awarded it Best in Show.
lore.legendary: She runs between heartbeats with a coat woven from the west wind. Entire kingdoms have waited centuries for her to come when called.

names.legendary: Mosaic, Commander of the Thousand Paws

lore.common: Its patchy coat looks like spilled paint, so art teachers keep trying to frame it.
lore.uncommon: Its round ears can hear a sandwich being unwrapped across the savannah. It always arrives before the crumbs.
lore.rare: The pack votes by sneezing, and Sneezarch counts every vote. Nobody has ever requested a recount.
lore.epic: Led a perfectly coordinated charge across the plains. Even the gazelles joined the formation, unsure which side they were on.
lore.legendary: When Mosaic calls, a thousand painted paws answer as one. Even the thunder falls silent to discover which way the pack will run.

names.legendary: Airedrake, Sovereign of Scruff

lore.common: Digs up the flowerbed to bury one biscuit, then forgets which hole it used.
lore.uncommon: Can herd chickens, fetch boots and guard a farm. Draws the line at doing the washing-up.
lore.rare: Barks orders into rabbit burrows until every rabbit comes out to lodge a formal complaint.
lore.epic: Delivered every parcel in town before breakfast and appointed itself mayor. The old mayor now fetches the newspaper.
lore.legendary: Wears a crown forged from the whiskers of ancient kings. Immediately buries it in the garden for safekeeping.

names.legendary: Staffurion, Guardian of the Gentle Heart

lore.common: Built like a brick with a wagging tail. Has never met a lap it considered too small.
lore.uncommon: Smiles at strangers until they surrender and scratch its ears. It calls this diplomacy.
lore.rare: Can pull a farm cart uphill with its teeth, but refuses to move unless its favourite squeaky duck is aboard.
lore.epic: Charged through a castle gate to defend its owner from a terrible menace. The menace was a balloon. The gate needed replacing.
lore.legendary: Staffurion once held a collapsing bridge steady so a village could cross. Afterward it demanded only one reward: someone, anyone, to throw the ball again.

names.legendary: Appenzor, Warden of the Alpine Herd

lore.common: Barks at cows on cheese wrappers. It takes its responsibilities as farm security very seriously.
lore.uncommon: Counts every cow in the valley and howls when one is late. The cows have started wearing disguises.
lore.rare: Its bark ricochets from mountain to mountain, guiding lost herds home. It also guides every disappointed echo back to its owner.
lore.epic: Rallied a thousand scattered cows with one howl, creating a living avalanche of bells down the mountain. The dairy industry called it an excellent quarter.
lore.legendary: Appenzor walks the misty passes where lost herds vanish. Its curled tail is a beacon through the snow, and its bark calls even the oldest mountain spirits to attention.

names.legendary: Dundaruff, Sentinel of the Red Dust

lore.common: Mistakes every garden hose for a snake. Has proudly saved the household from fourteen hoses this week.
lore.uncommon: Can smell a barbecue from the next postcode. Appears at the grill before the sausages do.
lore.rare: Stared down a crocodile at the billabong until it backed away in embarrassment. Has been insufferable ever since.
lore.epic: Challenged an entire kangaroo mob to a hopping contest and won by sheer stubbornness. The kangaroos now require written invitations to his paddock.
lore.legendary: Dundaruff once guarded a remote sheep station through a hundred nights of desert storms. It still patrols the red dust, fearless before anything except the vacuum cleaner.

names.legendary: Nefertiti, Queen of the Silent Bark

lore.common: Never barks at the doorbell. Yodels at it with the confidence of a failed opera singer.
lore.uncommon: Washes itself like a cat, then judges the actual cat for having poor technique.
lore.rare: Can raid a barbecue so silently the sausages don't realise they're missing.
lore.epic: Sang one impossible yodel across the valley and summoned every goat into a chorus. The cathedral choir resigned on principle.
lore.legendary: Ancient desert courts bowed to the dog that refused to bark. Her silent command can still halt a pack of hunting hounds mid-howl.

names.legendary: Sir Bartholomew, Duke of Long Ears

lore.common: Trips over its own ears, then lies on the floor looking betrayed by gravity.
lore.uncommon: Tracks a smell for six kilometres. Takes the first five hours to decide whether to begin.
lore.rare: Its enormous ears can hear a sandwich being opened in the next village. The legs arrive on Thursday.
lore.epic: Mourned one fallen biscuit so loudly the entire town held a minute's silence. The biscuit was later found under its chin.
lore.legendary: His ears cover both pavements when he sleeps. Every royal procession has to request permission to cross the duke's nose.

names.legendary: Sergeant Sniffwell, Last of the Trail

lore.common: Follows a smell out of the garden and returns carrying someone else's barbecue invitation.
lore.uncommon: Knows exactly which pocket contains treats, even when the coat belongs to a stranger.
lore.rare: Solved the mystery of a stolen sandwich by interrogating every picnic blanket in the park.
lore.epic: Led two hundred dogs through the city in pursuit of one invisible sausage aroma. The parade accidentally elected a mayor.
lore.legendary: Can track a single breadcrumb through centuries of rain and snow. His greatest unsolved mystery is who closed the fridge.

names.legendary: The Wolf in Lamb's Clothing

lore.common: Looks so much like a lamb that the flock keeps asking where its mother is.
lore.uncommon: Sprints like a racing dog but insists on wearing the hairstyle of a decorative cushion.
lore.rare: Infiltrated the sheep pen for a week before anyone noticed it was issuing orders.
lore.epic: Won both the sheepdog trial and the sheep beauty contest in the same afternoon. The judges are still arguing.
lore.legendary: An ancient hunter wearing the fleece of innocence. The shepherds tell stories of a harmless little lamb that once commanded every wolf in the valley.

names.legendary: Bernhard, the Mountain's Gentle Heart

lore.common: Sits on your feet to stop you leaving. Does not recognise the word appointment.
lore.uncommon: Pulls cheese carts down mountain paths and only eats the samples offered as payment.
lore.rare: Leans against strangers with the confidence of an old friend. Several tourists have ended up in the lake.
lore.epic: Rolled happily down the snowy slope and became an avalanche of fluff. The ski patrol replaced its rescue dogs with brushes.
lore.legendary: When a winter village was buried in snow, Bernhard dug it free and carried everyone home in his coat. His greatest reward was a very small biscuit.

names.legendary: Old Bellowgrave, Hound of the Lost Scent

lore.common: Barks up the wrong tree so passionately that the squirrel apologises and moves in.
lore.uncommon: Can follow a single chip's smell from three towns away. The chip never stood a chance.
lore.rare: Bay after bay rattles the windows until the whole neighbourhood hums along in self-defence.
lore.epic: Called across the mountains one full-moon night and every hound answered. The town's church bells joined in out of fear of being left out.
lore.legendary: He has followed trails older than maps, tracing one legendary raccoon that may never have existed. The trees tell him otherwise.

names.legendary: Duchess Blenhelia of the Velvet Throne

lore.common: Claims your lap just as you need to stand up. Your legs are no longer legally yours.
lore.uncommon: Can beg a biscuit out of someone who does not own biscuits. Nobody understands how.
lore.rare: Turned one sad-eyed glance into a lifetime supply of cake at the local cafe. The baker considers it an honour.
lore.epic: Became the royal family's chief adviser by sitting on the king's documents. The laws now include mandatory afternoon naps.
lore.legendary: Dynasties have risen and fallen around her velvet cushion. She remembers every monarch's name, but responds only to the rustle of a treat bag.

names.legendary: Inspector Droolock, Scent of Truth

lore.common: Leaves a puddle on every seat before sitting somewhere else. It calls this reserving a table.
lore.uncommon: Can smell last Tuesday's breakfast through three walls. It disapproves of your toast.
lore.rare: Identified a lost earring on the bottom of a lake by sniffing the lake's reflection.
lore.epic: Followed one sausage scent across five countries and accidentally solved an international mystery. The sausage remains at large.
lore.legendary: Every scent ever lost lives somewhere in Droolock's wrinkles. He once tracked a king's vanished crown by following the smell of a guilty barber.

names.legendary: Bluebellow, Hunter of Lost Trails

lore.common: Is covered in blue speckles and insists they are camouflage. On the white sofa, they are not.
lore.uncommon: Can tell a raccoon from a cat in absolute darkness. Both animals wish it couldn't.
lore.rare: Bays so loudly that sleeping owls fall out of their trees. The owls are drafting a complaint.
lore.epic: Tracked a scent through three snowstorms, twelve rivers and a wedding buffet. The missing raccoon was found eating the cake.
lore.legendary: Bluebellow once followed a trail no creature could smell, right into a town erased from maps. He brought back its church bell and an unpaid parking ticket.

names.legendary: Professor Woolsworth, Herd Genius

lore.common: Herds the family into the kitchen at six, regardless of whether anybody wanted dinner.
lore.uncommon: Learns the names of every toy and gets offended if you call the frisbee a ball.
lore.rare: Can line up a hundred sheep with one stern look. The sheep now practise standing to attention.
lore.epic: Herded all the clouds into one corner of the sky to give farmers a month of sunshine. Meteorologists have requested an interview.
lore.legendary: Woolsworth once sorted every sheep in a kingdom by height, colour and favourite grass. Then demanded a more intellectually challenging job.

names.legendary: McScruff, the Unburrowable Menace

lore.common: Looks like a damp otter and regards every family photograph as a chance to prove it.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes into a tiny hole and comes out wearing half the flowerbed.
lore.rare: Chased a mole underground for so long that the mole sent a postcard from its new address.
lore.epic: Out-dug an industrial excavator at the building site and immediately buried the operator's lunch as a victory trophy.
lore.legendary: Once tunnelled beneath an entire castle to catch a single mouse. The castle was relocated six feet to the left; the mouse remains unbothered.

names.legendary: Countess Borzova, the Endless Silhouette

lore.common: Faints gracefully whenever someone mentions bath time. The carpet is becoming concerned.
lore.uncommon: Has legs so elegantly folded that guests mistake it for expensive furniture.
lore.rare: Chases squirrels without looking hurried. It makes forty miles an hour seem like a gentle stroll.
lore.epic: Attended a royal ball and outran every carriage while wearing a silk ribbon. The horses asked for early retirement.
lore.legendary: Borzova's long nose has pointed the way for lost travellers through seven winters. She will accept no reward except a sofa worthy of her profile.

names.legendary: Sir Bostonium, Duke of the Bow Tie

lore.common: Snores like a baby tractor and wakes up surprised that anyone noticed.
lore.uncommon: Wears a permanent tuxedo and refuses to eat dinner without being seated formally.
lore.rare: Stares with enormous eyes until the last crisp levitates off your plate and into its mouth.
lore.epic: Joined an orchestra by snoring through the entire overture. Critics called the performance daringly modern.
lore.legendary: Sir Bostonium once hosted peace talks between rival dog packs in a velvet tuxedo. The agreement was signed in drool and promptly eaten.

names.legendary: Bouvard, Iron Shepherd of Flanders

lore.common: Has so much fringe that it once spent an afternoon guarding the wrong garden gnome.
lore.uncommon: Moves cattle with a single disappointed stare. The cows would rather not discuss it.
lore.rare: Hides whole lost objects in its shaggy coat. Last winter's missing shovel has just resurfaced.
lore.epic: Herded every runaway cow at the market back to its pen, plus the entire vegetable stall. The carrots are now exceptionally obedient.
lore.legendary: Bouvard hauled the harvest through three floods when the roads were gone. The villagers built him a statue; he promptly leaned against it until it tilted.

names.legendary: Bark Tyson, Heavyweight of Happiness

lore.common: Greets visitors by launching its entire body into the air. Personal space remains a mystery.
lore.uncommon: Boxes the air with its front paws whenever excited. It is always excited.
lore.rare: Knocked the sofa across the room with one enthusiastic wiggle. The sofa has requested a transfer.
lore.epic: Entered the boxing ring against a professional champion, won by jumping repeatedly into his arms, and demanded a biscuit instead of a belt.
lore.legendary: Bark Tyson has never lost a match, mostly because every opponent ends up playing fetch. His championship trophy doubles as a food bowl.

names.legendary: Griffonius, Judge of a Thousand Fools

lore.common: Looks permanently disappointed in the family. The family has started apologising pre-emptively.
lore.uncommon: Rides in the front seat and criticises the driver's parking with a single raised eyebrow.
lore.rare: Won a staring contest against a statue. The statue eventually looked away out of embarrassment.
lore.epic: Sat on the royal bench and dismissed an entire courtroom with a glance. Even the bailiff bowed before leaving.
lore.legendary: Griffonius has judged kings, witches and suspiciously optimistic salesmen. Nobody has ever won a case against his left eyebrow.

names.legendary: Briardius, Keeper of the Hundred Flocks

lore.common: Has such a magnificent fringe that it once argued with the wrong door.
lore.uncommon: Stays so close to the flock that the sheep think it is their collective shadow.
lore.rare: Herds guests at parties into neat corners while everyone insists they are choosing where to stand.
lore.epic: A gust blew its fringe out of its eyes. The sheep saw the legendary stare for the first time and lined up before anyone asked.
lore.legendary: Briardius once guided an entire city to safety during a blizzard by herding the streetlights into a path. It still refuses a haircut.

names.legendary: Brittanix, Arrow of the Endless Hunt

lore.common: Points at every pigeon until a person acknowledges its excellent observation.
lore.uncommon: Finds feathers in fields from incredible distances, then proudly brings back the wrong bird.
lore.rare: Runs four laps around the meadow while everyone else is still putting on their shoes.
lore.epic: Held a perfect pointing pose at the mayor's roof so long the council installed it as a new weathervane. The pigeons took offence.
lore.legendary: Brittanix has followed the same migrating star across a hundred autumn skies. At dawn it always returns to the one person who remembered its favourite ball.

names.legendary: Brutus the Unbarking, Last Gatekeeper

lore.common: Sleeps across the doorway and requires every visitor to climb over its belly.
lore.uncommon: Can approach silently despite weighing as much as a sofa. The drool arrives first.
lore.rare: Stopped an entire flock of mischievous geese with one look. The geese now use another street.
lore.epic: Sat down on the royal drawbridge and refused to move for an invading army. Both sides agreed to postpone the battle until after his nap.
lore.legendary: Brutus watched the fortress gates through forty winters without a single bark. The only thief who ever entered came back to return a stolen blanket.

names.legendary: Cairnathor, Lord of the Buried Hills

lore.common: Barks at a suspicious pebble for forty minutes. The pebble eventually apologises.
lore.uncommon: Digs after a rat and emerges wearing half the flowerbed like a victory crown.
lore.rare: Can sniff a creature beneath three feet of stone and tunnel straight to its lunch.
lore.epic: Dug beneath a castle looking for a rabbit and resurfaced in the throne room. The king offered it a position in mining.
lore.legendary: The hills of the Highlands are merely Cairnathor's oldest digging piles. When he scratches his ear, archaeologists discover another forgotten kingdom.

names.legendary: Cardigorn, Marshal of the Endless Herd

lore.common: Climbs stairs one at a time and announces every conquered step with a triumphant bark.
lore.uncommon: Herds cows by nipping at their heels. The cows have filed a height-discrimination complaint.
lore.rare: Can herd an entire family into one room without leaving its cushion. Only its eyes move.
lore.epic: Rounded up every guest at a wedding and formed an impeccable conga line. The bride had to request permission to leave.
lore.legendary: Cardigorn once herded the stars into their constellations while standing on legs barely taller than teacups. The moon still refuses to be bossed around.

names.legendary: Admiral Cheswick, Lord of the Frozen Bay

lore.common: Returns from every walk dripping wet. The weather forecast insists it never rained.
lore.uncommon: Its waterproof coat sheds rain straight onto whoever has just put on clean trousers.
lore.rare: Retrieves lost gloves from icy water and refuses to hand them over without a biscuit-shaped ransom.
lore.epic: Split the frozen bay in two with one dive to fetch a rubber duck. The ice skaters now use the gap as a canal.
lore.legendary: Admiral Cheswick has crossed winter seas to retrieve the same battered tennis ball for seven generations. The ball belongs to nobody, but the admiral remains fiercely loyal.

names.legendary: El Chihuacabra, Terror of the Doorbell

lore.common: Shivers beneath three blankets, then declares war on the radiator for not being warm enough.
lore.uncommon: Growls at a Great Dane from the safety of a handbag. Believes it won the confrontation.
lore.rare: Can intimidate moving vans with a bark barely bigger than a hiccup. The drivers still reverse.
lore.epic: Challenged the entire dog show to single combat and chased the judges into the trophy cupboard. It kept the largest cup.
lore.legendary: El Chihuacabra is believed to be the most dangerous creature in the kingdom, according to El Chihuacabra. His bark has frightened dragons, postmen and one particularly fragile lawn ornament.

names.legendary: Chowdorius, Emperor of the Silent Snub

lore.common: Looks like a teddy bear that has discovered taxes. Does not approve.
lore.uncommon: Displays its blue tongue to strangers like an official royal document.
lore.rare: Can stare down a lion without moving a muscle. The lion eventually offers it the better cushion.
lore.epic: Shook its mane during the grand parade and buried the entire marching band beneath golden fur. The band played on from inside.
lore.legendary: Chowdorius ruled a palace for a decade without a single command. Servants obeyed his raised eyebrow, and the actual emperor was moved to the garden for making too much noise.

names.legendary: His Grace Clumbersome, Lord of Naps

lore.common: Sleeps through the doorbell, thunder and its own dinner announcement. Wakes for toast.
lore.uncommon: Walks with the gravity of a royal procession, only significantly slower.
lore.rare: Can make an entire park fall quiet by settling down for a nap. Even the squirrels tiptoe.
lore.epic: Lay across the mansion staircase during a royal visit. The procession waited seven hours while he dreamed of biscuits.
lore.legendary: His Grace inherited a noble hunting lineage and rejected the chase as undignified. Legend says his snores taught thunder how to roll across the hills.

names.legendary: Lady Cockering, Huntress of Mud

lore.common: Dips both ears into dinner and carries the gravy around as perfume.
lore.uncommon: Wags so hard that the entire back half of its body negotiates independently.
lore.rare: Can sniff a pheasant through brick walls. Once pointed at the headmaster's desk and uncovered a very surprised duck.
lore.epic: Led the village hunt through five muddy fields and returned with the mayor's missing slippers. The pheasants had escaped three hours earlier.
lore.legendary: Lady Cockering hears the splash of a puddle from beyond the horizon. Her ears have sailed across rivers, forests and several extremely offended picnic tables.

names.legendary: Lassara, Guardian of the Last Lost Lamb

lore.common: Barks at the postman every day, then greets him as a long-lost brother.
lore.uncommon: Leaves enough fur on every hedge to outfit a small sheep. The birds have started a textile industry.
lore.rare: Guides lost wanderers home through fog, then insists on herding their entire family into one room.
lore.epic: Unfurled its enormous coat across the hills and sheltered an entire flock from a winter gale. The sheep now pay rent in wool.
lore.legendary: Lassara once crossed a moonless moor to find a lamb hidden in the mist between worlds. She brought it back at dawn and still checks every shadow in case another is missing.

names.legendary: Curlathor, Warden of All Lost Things

lore.common: Arrives home from the pond wearing enough weeds to pass as a shrub.
lore.uncommon: Dries its curly coat with one shake. Everybody else requires three towels.
lore.rare: Returns everything thrown into water, including canoes and deeply offended fishermen.
lore.epic: Retrieved every lost ball from the lake in one afternoon. The football club now plays on a mountain of tennis balls.
lore.legendary: Was sent to recover a crown lost beneath an enchanted sea. Returned with the crown, the throne and a confused octopus that refuses to leave its curls.

names.legendary: Dalmatron, Keeper of the Hundred Stars

lore.common: Has 101 excuses for stealing sausages, one for each imaginary spot.
lore.uncommon: Runs beside every passing horse carriage like it personally invented roads.
lore.rare: Rearranges its spots into a map of the next firehouse emergency. The firefighters are learning to read dog.
lore.epic: Raced a burning sunset across the city to lead the fire brigade home. Every traffic light turned green out of respect.
lore.legendary: Was born beneath a meteor shower, each falling star leaving a dark spot on its coat. When the last star falls, Dalmatron will be there to catch it.

names.legendary: Dinmontius, Baron of Borrowed Burrows

lore.common: Wears a pompom hairstyle that survives everything except a light drizzle.
lore.uncommon: Walks under the sofa with the self-importance of a royal procession.
lore.rare: Burrows after badgers and emerges wearing their abandoned possessions.
lore.epic: Shook its enormous topknot at the village dog show and sent every judge's wig airborne. It won Best in Show.
lore.legendary: Once followed a badger into a hollow hill and returned with the keys to an underground castle. Refuses to open it until everyone compliments the haircut.

names.legendary: Dholeth, Sovereign of the Whistling Wild

lore.common: Whistles to call its friends, then hides when everyone turns around.
lore.uncommon: Its fiery coat makes sunset look like a cheap imitation.
lore.rare: Leads its pack through the jungle without leaving a single member behind. Even the slow ones arrive for dinner.
lore.epic: Summoned a thousand echoing whistles across the mountain passes. Every traveller found the road home; every predator pretended not to hear.
lore.legendary: The ancient forest gave Dholeth the voice of its hidden paths. When a pack grows lost, one whistle can guide them through darkness no map remembers.

names.legendary: Dobermortis, Warden of the Black Gate

lore.common: Guards the front door with military precision. Lets the cat in without checking its papers.
lore.uncommon: Can hear a biscuit packet open four rooms away and considers that a security breach.
lore.rare: Patrols so silently that burglars apologize before realizing it is behind them.
lore.epic: Single-pawedly secured the royal vault, then arrested the treasurer for bringing the wrong treats. No one dared object.
lore.legendary: The Black Gate has never been crossed by an unwelcome visitor, for Dobermortis knows every heartbeat that approaches. It has one weakness: belly rubs.

names.legendary: Lord Baychester of the Endless Chase

lore.common: Hears a hunting horn and immediately investigates the nearest sandwich.
lore.uncommon: Runs with the pack all day but insists on singing the loudest part.
lore.rare: Can follow a scent across three counties and still lose its own supper bowl.
lore.epic: Led forty hounds through the village festival in perfect formation. By the end, the cake competition had become a choir and the mayor was baying on the podium.
lore.legendary: Chased the very first echo through the English hills and never caught it. On misty nights, Baychester's voice is heard from every valley at once, each demanding another biscuit.

names.legendary: Lady Belton of the Silent Meadow

lore.common: Points at pigeons, paintings of pigeons and a particularly convincing potato.
lore.uncommon: Has a speckled coat like spilled pepper. The cook once tried to season it.
lore.rare: Freezes so perfectly among the reeds that the birds have started hanging coats on it.
lore.epic: Held a pointing pose through an entire village fete. The council unveiled a plaque, then screamed when the statue asked for a sausage.
lore.legendary: Belton once pointed at a bird that had not yet been born. A hundred years later it hatched at exactly the spot she chose; she remains smug but impeccably still.

names.legendary: Duke Springalot of the Lost Tennis Balls

lore.common: Bounces at every visitor as though guests were invented five minutes ago.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into hedges and emerges with twigs, leaves and somebody else's picnic.
lore.rare: Can identify the deepest mud in any field and bring a sample home in its ears.
lore.epic: Burst through the royal maze in one leap and scattered the hedge into a thousand green moustaches. The palace gardeners are demanding a rematch.
lore.legendary: Retrieved every tennis ball lost in Britain and deposited them on one doorstep. The mountain can be seen from space; Duke Springalot is still waiting for someone to throw one.

names.legendary: Baron Entlebark, Cloud Shepherd

lore.common: Rounds up chair legs because there are never enough cows in the kitchen.
lore.uncommon: Is the smallest Swiss mountain dog in the room and has written several letters about the disrespect.
lore.rare: Can herd an entire field of cattle with one stare. The tractor has asked it for lessons.
lore.epic: Herded the village cows into the mayor's garden and organised them by height. The flower show became a very confused livestock auction.
lore.legendary: So determined was Entlebark to herd the clouds that the rain began falling in tidy rows. Farmers still consult his bark before planning the harvest.

names.legendary: Nanuk, Guardian of the White Road

lore.common: Thinks the freezer is the best room in the house. Has applied to sleep beside the peas.
lore.uncommon: Builds itself a snow bed, then refuses to come in until someone brings a blanket for the blanket.
lore.rare: Runs a sled faster than the wind and still has time to sniff every interesting snowdrift.
lore.epic: Pulled a lost expedition through a whiteout while the northern lights followed like a string of lanterns. The captain had to admit the dog knew the way.
lore.legendary: Nanuk guided travellers across an Arctic winter when the stars disappeared. Its pawprints still glow faintly on the oldest ice, leading home and occasionally to a sausage stall.

names.legendary: Waggleby, the Eternal Puppy

lore.common: Is ten years old and still reacts to a ball as though it has just been invented.
lore.uncommon: Its glossy coat reflects the sun into the neighbour's window. The neighbour thinks the dog is signalling for help.
lore.rare: Can retrieve a stick thrown into the sea from any shore. Returns with a beach chair as a bonus.
lore.epic: Fetched every stick on the beach before the tide went out. The lifeguards declared an emergency after their tower vanished under the pile.
lore.legendary: Waggleby once retrieved a star that fell into a dark lake and carried it home without a single scratch. The night sky still wags its brightest light whenever he barks.

names.legendary: Napoleon Snortaparte

lore.common: Snores louder than a lawnmower and blames the cat.
lore.uncommon: Tilts its enormous ears toward the fridge whenever a cheese wrapper whispers.
lore.rare: Refuses every walk unless the destination has a cafe. Has learned to read menus.
lore.epic: Floated across Paris on its batlike ears during a gust. Landed on the mayor's dinner and demanded a cushion.
lore.legendary: Napoleon Snortaparte conquered the capital without barking once. His strategy involved sitting on every important document until someone brought him cheese.

names.legendary: Oberhund, Guardian of Lost Things

lore.common: Lies across the doorway with one ear up, so you can never tell if it is asleep. Neither can it.
lore.uncommon: Knows a crisp packet has been opened three streets away. Will investigate without a warrant.
lore.rare: Tracks a single lost glove through a busy market. Returns with the glove and somebody else's lunch.
lore.epic: Organised the police station so efficiently that the officers began submitting holiday requests to the dog.
lore.legendary: Oberhund once guarded a mountain pass through a hundred winters. When the last traveller was safe, he finally lay down and demanded a very large sausage.

names.legendary: Baroness Pointara, the Unerring

lore.common: Points at the fridge every time you walk into the kitchen, just in case you missed it.
lore.uncommon: Points at the fridge every morning, then looks shocked when nobody offers a reward.
lore.rare: Follows a scent so eagerly that it forgets the person holding the lead.
lore.epic: Stood motionless before a hiding pheasant while the entire hunting party walked past. The pheasant was deeply impressed.
lore.legendary: Pointara once indicated a lost star in the heavens. Astronomers followed her nose and discovered an entire constellation shaped like a biscuit.

names.legendary: Kaiser Schnauz, Sentinel of the Gates

lore.common: Raises one bushy eyebrow at the hoover. The hoover has started switching itself off.
lore.uncommon: Raises one formidable eyebrow at visitors. Even the postman straightens his tie.
lore.rare: Guards its favourite sofa cushion as though it contains the crown jewels.
lore.epic: Took over security at the village festival and made every pigeon show identification. The pigeons now carry tiny passes.
lore.legendary: Kaiser Schnauz defended a castle with a single stern look. Invaders laid down their banners, apologised for their muddy boots and offered to sweep the courtyard.

names.legendary: Goldie Goodheart, Friend of Strangers

lore.common: Brings you a shoe every time you come home. Never a matching pair.
lore.uncommon: Greets the burglar like an old friend and shows him where the biscuits are.
lore.rare: Can carry two tennis balls in its mouth at once and still smile.
lore.epic: Made friends with every single person in the city in one walk. The walk took nine hours.
lore.legendary: Was awarded the nation's friendliest medal and immediately gave it to the stranger next to it.

names.legendary: Lady Gordonia, Sentinel of the Glen

lore.common: Takes years and years to grow up and spends all of them chewing the doormat.
lore.uncommon: Sniffs every stone on the moor as though it contains breaking news.
lore.rare: Points at a hidden grouse through fog so thick the hunters cannot see their own boots. Has never once pointed at the correct lunch bag.
lore.epic: Bounded across the Highlands to warn three villages of a storm. Arrived with a wet tennis ball that nobody recognised.
lore.legendary: Lady Gordonia guards the misty glens where lost travellers wander. Her black-and-tan coat appears like a beacon before the path home is revealed.

names.legendary: Duke Danelot, the Gentle Tower

lore.common: Sits in your lap with the confidence of a chihuahua and the weight of a sofa.
lore.uncommon: Tries to curl up in the cat's basket. The cat has started charging rent for overflow space.
lore.rare: Resting its chin on the dining table, it can inspect every plate without standing up. The biscuits are missing.
lore.epic: Rolled over in its sleep and pushed the living-room wall into next door's garden. The neighbours have asked it to roll back.
lore.legendary: Danelot once stood watch over a sleeping city, mistaking its tallest tower for a scratching post. The tower still has a very polite pawprint near the clock.

names.legendary: Pyrenella, Shield of the White Pass

lore.common: Barks at a falling leaf with the conviction of a soldier defending a castle.
lore.uncommon: Blends into the flock so completely that the shepherd has accidentally sheared its tail twice.
lore.rare: Patrols the mountainside all night, warning wolves, shadows and one suspiciously shaped snowdrift to stay back.
lore.epic: Gathered an entire lost flock into a ring of white fur during a blizzard. Rescuers found the sheep snoring inside a giant living snowball.
lore.legendary: The mountain spirits entrusted Pyrenella with guarding the first lamb of spring. It stood through seven winters, and even the avalanches learned to take the long way round.

names.legendary: Baron Brunnli, the Mountain Mover

lore.common: Pulls its owner down the pavement as though the lead were attached to a cart of cheese.
lore.uncommon: Delivers milk down the mountain and takes payment exclusively in chin scratches.
lore.rare: Can haul a wagon full of barrels uphill while the cart driver struggles to carry one sandwich.
lore.epic: Pulled the entire village market over the pass when the bridge collapsed. Business resumed before the cheese stall opened.
lore.legendary: Baron Brunnli pulled the winter moon above the Alp when it became stuck behind a summit. The cowbells rang in thanks for three days.

names.legendary: Nocturna, the Velvet Flockwarden

lore.common: Collects so many burrs in its black coat that the garden seems to be following it home.
lore.uncommon: Stares at a rustling crisp packet as though interrogating a spy.
lore.rare: Herds sheep by moving like a shadow around the flock. The sheep now fear the dark less than the farmer does.
lore.epic: Guided a lost flock home on a moonless night. The village woke to find every sheep asleep in its own numbered pen.
lore.legendary: Nocturna walked beside the first shepherd through a night without stars. It carried the path home in its eyes, and every lost lamb since has followed that distant gleam.

names.legendary: Lady Podenca of the Seven Leaps

lore.common: Hears a biscuit wrapper open from the opposite end of the beach.
lore.uncommon: Leaps straight up whenever the word 'walk' is spoken, even in a whisper.
lore.rare: Clears the garden wall chasing a rabbit and returns wearing the neighbour's washing.
lore.epic: Jumped clear over the harbour and landed in a fishing boat. The captain made it first mate after it spotted the next wave.
lore.legendary: Podenca once crossed seven island cliffs in seven leaps to bring a lost child home. Even the seabirds bowed as her great ears cut the wind.

names.legendary: Ruby O'Setter, Heart of the Wild Wind

lore.common: Runs in circles when the lead appears, then forgets what the excitement was about.
lore.uncommon: Wears a shining red coat and still manages to find the muddiest puddle in the county.
lore.rare: Outruns the postman, the milk van and its own shadow before breakfast.
lore.epic: Bounced through every muddy field at the spring fair, painting the entire village brown. The farmers awarded it best landscape artist.
lore.legendary: Ruby O'Setter carried a lost shepherd's whistle across the moors through a storm. Her red coat glowed like a beacon, and the flock followed her safely home.

names.legendary: Seamus Redwhisker, the Unbowed

lore.common: Challenges the garden gnome to a staring contest and loses only when dinner is called.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a polite red-haired gentleman until a squirrel insults its fence.
lore.rare: Charges through the thickest bog after a rabbit and returns wearing enough peat to start a garden.
lore.epic: Led a one-dog rebellion against the cows occupying its favourite field. By sunset every cow had moved two fields over.
lore.legendary: Seamus once guarded a mountain village against a pack of wolves three times his size. They returned every winter to ask whether the fearless red dog had finally retired.

names.legendary: Clancy, the Curly King of the Deep

lore.common: Wags its strange bare tail so proudly that nearby dogs look confused.
lore.uncommon: Treats every muddy puddle as a private swimming pool and invites the owner in.
lore.rare: Can retrieve a stick from the far bank while a line of ducks follows as an admiring audience.
lore.epic: Leapt into the village regatta and splashed every rowing crew into second place. The officials awarded it a trophy shaped like a fish.
lore.legendary: Clancy once dove into the enchanted lake to retrieve a moonbeam trapped beneath the reeds. He emerged wearing a crown of silver curls, and the lake has shone brighter ever since.

names.legendary: Brannagh, Keeper of the Last Castle

lore.common: Ducks under every doorway and still bumps its head on the hanging lamp.
lore.uncommon: Lets the kitten sleep on its nose and won't move until the kitten has finished dreaming.
lore.rare: Stands tall enough to peer over the castle wall and warn the guards of approaching visitors.
lore.epic: Walked into a ruined castle and every empty suit of armour bowed as it passed. The tour guide resigned in amazement.
lore.legendary: Brannagh guarded an abandoned castle through seven generations of winter. When the family finally returned, he greeted them at the gate as if they'd only been gone an afternoon.

names.legendary: Signora Velocetta, Duchess of Sunbeams

lore.common: Regards rain as a personal insult and refuses to step beyond the doorway.
lore.uncommon: Owns more knitted jumpers than its human and judges the stitching on all of them.
lore.rare: Can sprint across the courtyard so swiftly that even the pigeons forget to fly away.
lore.epic: Chased a runaway scarf around the piazza and spun every café umbrella into a whirl. The customers applauded while holding their espresso cups.
lore.legendary: Velocetta found the last warm sunbeam during the coldest Italian winter in memory. She refused to move, and by morning the whole town had gathered around her patch of sunlight.

names.legendary: Princess Chin, Keeper of the Moonlit Fan

lore.common: Spins in a tiny circle every time it receives a compliment.
lore.uncommon: Grooms itself like a cat and chooses the highest cushion in the room.
lore.rare: Walks through an entire palace without making a sound, appearing on laps before anybody notices.
lore.epic: Climbed the grand silk curtains and demanded that dinner be served beside the chandelier. The servants complied.
lore.legendary: Princess Chin once kept a lonely empress company through a thousand moonlit evenings. Her silk cushion remains warm in the palace even when the great hall stands empty.

names.legendary: Captain Kees, the Floating Cloud

lore.common: Its markings look like little glasses, so everyone expects it to be clever. It is mostly clever about cheese.
lore.uncommon: Smiles at complete strangers until they confess where the cheese is hidden. It never stops smiling.
lore.rare: Patrols the canal towpath and barks once for every bridge. The lock keeper now asks its permission to open the gates.
lore.epic: Shook out its coat during the canal festival and buried the judges in a blizzard of fluff. First prize went to a suspiciously furry barge.
lore.legendary: Captain Kees once guided a lost convoy of barges through the fog by standing on the bow and shining its spectacles at the moon. The ducks still salute its passing.

names.legendary: Kelpira, General of the Outback

lore.common: Herds the chickens into the pantry, then demands a medal for protecting the biscuits.
lore.uncommon: Runs across the flock's backs without touching the ground. Sheep have requested a speed limit.
lore.rare: Directs a scattered flock using only its eyes. The farmer has stopped giving orders and started taking notes.
lore.epic: Gathered every sheep from seven stations before breakfast, then arranged the wool into a portrait of the farmer. The farmer looked considerably fluffier.
lore.legendary: Kelpira can hear a lost lamb call across the sunburnt plains. Once, it herded a thunderstorm into the reservoir instead; the drought ended, and the clouds now obey whistles.

names.legendary: Lady Kerrigan, the Blue Rebel

lore.common: Was born black and slowly turned blue. It insists this is a perfectly normal career progression.
lore.uncommon: Wears a magnificent beard and uses it to mop up crumbs at forbidden dinner parties.
lore.rare: Challenged a badger, the vacuum cleaner and its own reflection to a duel. All three backed away.
lore.epic: Led an uprising of terriers against every lawnmower on the estate. The gardens are wild now, but morale has never been higher.
lore.legendary: Lady Kerrigan's coat turned the blue of a coming storm. Legend says the first raindrop always waits for her bark, and the hills answer in thunder.

names.legendary: Komondria, the Walking Winter

lore.common: Gets mistaken for a mop and looks personally offended when someone reaches for the bucket.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into a flock of sheep; the shepherd counts one extra cloud at sunset.
lore.rare: Its heavy cords turn a wolf's bite into a mouthful of embarrassing wool.
lore.epic: Shook its wet coat at the village sheep show and created a weather event. The judges awarded first prize to the umbrella stand.
lore.legendary: Komondria watched over the first winter flock while snow fell for forty nights. When the shepherd returned, the sheep were safe beneath a vast white guardian, and the wolves had forgotten the path.

names.legendary: Kuvaszar, Guardian of the Silent Throne

lore.common: Barks at the garden shed as though it has been plotting a coup.
lore.uncommon: Blends into fresh snow, but its very serious barking always gives away its position.
lore.rare: Guards the royal crown so fiercely that the king has to fill out a borrowing form.
lore.epic: Held the mountain pass through a winter storm while the flock slept safely behind it. The wolves returned with an apology and a map of another valley.
lore.legendary: Kuvaszar once refused the king's velvet throne and slept before the palace gates instead. The royal line has passed for centuries, but its white shadow still guards every traveller who seeks refuge.

names.legendary: Lord Labradore, the Golden Retriever

lore.common: Finishes breakfast in four seconds, then looks heartbroken that nobody has fed it.
lore.uncommon: Wags so enthusiastically that cups evacuate the coffee table.
lore.rare: Can sniff a forgotten biscuit through three coat pockets and a locked cupboard.
lore.epic: Stole every sausage at the village barbecue without being caught. The only evidence was a trail of happy tail prints across the tablecloth.
lore.legendary: Lord Labradore guided a caravan of lost travellers through a mountain blizzard. Its reward was a single biscuit, which it shared with no one, though it rescued everyone twice.

names.legendary: Lakely, the Little Lord of the Fells

lore.common: Challenges every boat on the lake to a race from the shore. It has yet to lose in its own mind.
lore.uncommon: Scrambles over wet rocks while hikers struggle to remain upright.
lore.rare: Squeezes through a crack in the fell and returns with a fox's lost lunch and a very angry fox.
lore.epic: Barked at the mountain rescue helicopter until it landed to investigate. It then showed the crew a shortcut nobody had discovered.
lore.legendary: Lakely guards the hidden paths between the old stone fells. Its bark once guided a hundred travellers safely through a blizzard, though it demanded a hundred sausages afterward.

names.legendary: Leonhard, the Gentle Lion of the Lake

lore.common: Blocks the cool kitchen tiles like a lion-shaped carpet with very strong opinions.
lore.uncommon: Carries a magnificent mane and lets kittens use it as a private hiding place.
lore.rare: Swims into rough water without hesitation, then returns carrying the lost beach ball and its very grateful owner.
lore.epic: Shook its great golden mane beside the lake and sent a wave rolling across the beach. The sunbathers declared a new tide.
lore.legendary: Leonhard watched over the old lakeside kingdom from a hill above the water. When a flood came, it carried the villagers to safety one by one, never once losing the smallest child or the family cat.

names.legendary: Lhamo, Lion of the Snow Gate

lore.common: Hides behind its long fringe and barks before it knows who is visiting.
lore.uncommon: Sweeps the monastery corridor with its flowing coat, then demands grooming as payment.
lore.rare: Knows the difference between friend and stranger before either reaches the mountain path.
lore.epic: Raised the alarm when a herd of runaway yaks approached the abbey. The monks rescued the prayer flags, and the yaks joined the morning chanting.
lore.legendary: Lhamo watched the snow gate above the cloud line for a hundred winters. Travellers still hear its small, fierce bark in blizzards, guiding them toward the warm doors of the mountain sanctuary.

names.legendary: Kodiak Stormpaw, Bearer of the North

lore.common: Answers questions with a long 'woo-woo' and waits very patiently for a response.
lore.uncommon: Digs itself a snow bed, then complains that the pillow is not deep enough.
lore.rare: Drags a supply sled through a blizzard while the humans argue about whose turn it is to pull.
lore.epic: Moved an entire Arctic campsite overnight because the scientists had pitched their tents in the way of its favourite snowdrift.
lore.legendary: Kodiak Stormpaw hauled the last winter caravan across a sea of frozen darkness. The stars still mark its footprints for lost travellers.

names.legendary: Major Malin, Who Never Sleeps

lore.common: Finishes three laps of the garden before the lead is clipped on.
lore.uncommon: Leaps high enough to inspect the top shelf whenever the doorbell rings.
lore.rare: Scales the training wall to rescue a lost tennis ball, then repeats the trick to show off.
lore.epic: Completed the police academy's obstacle course so fast that the instructor promoted the dog to head of training.
lore.legendary: Major Malin once outran the night to escort a lost child home before dawn. He returned at sunrise with the moon in his jaws and immediately demanded another mission.

names.legendary: Melitessa, the Little Queen of Clouds

lore.common: Sweeps crumbs from the kitchen floor with its trailing white coat and sends the bill.
lore.uncommon: Refuses every photograph until someone straightens the tiny bow above its eyes.
lore.rare: Glides so smoothly under its silken hair that the cat follows it looking for wheels.
lore.epic: Crossed a muddy royal garden without one dirty paw, leaving a perfect white ribbon of flowers in its wake.
lore.legendary: Melitessa once fell asleep on a passing cloud and was carried through seven kingdoms. Each princess she visited woke to find a silver bow under her pillow.

names.legendary: Xolotzin, Guide of the Ancient Fires

lore.common: Borrows a woolly jumper on chilly mornings and refuses to return it.
lore.uncommon: Feels like a tiny hot-water bottle whenever it curls up beside its owner.
lore.rare: Guards the warmest patch of sunshine with the determination of an ancient temple sentinel.
lore.epic: Turned the winter market into a parade of knitted dog coats, then judged the fashions with the sternest face in town.
lore.legendary: Xolotzin walked beside travellers on the old stone roads when the fires went dark. Stories say its warmth guided lost children home through the coldest nights.

names.legendary: Emperor Pinsch, Lord of the High Step

lore.common: Marches across the living room lifting its knees higher than the furniture.
lore.uncommon: Inspects every toy in the house before breakfast, issuing stern little barks.
lore.rare: Chases a much larger dog away from the garden and returns looking mildly disappointed at the lack of applause.
lore.epic: Took command of the town's parade and led the brass band around the square at double speed. Nobody dared challenge the smallest drum major.
lore.legendary: Emperor Pinsch once stood before an army of great hunting hounds and refused to yield a single inch of carpet. By dawn they had all sworn loyalty to his tiny throne.

names.legendary: Madame Frisette, Empress of the Shears

lore.common: Has a haircut fancier than yours and checks it in every shop window.
lore.uncommon: Learns a new trick every day and refuses to repeat the old ones.
lore.rare: Opened the fridge, the cupboard and the biscuit tin, then closed them to hide the evidence.
lore.epic: Swam through the royal regatta disguised as a cluster of floating pompoms. The ducks declared it their admiral and followed it into the palace fountains.
lore.legendary: Madame Frisette trimmed the royal hedges with such precision that they grew into a maze of dancing poodles. The king is still lost and refuses to admit it.

names.legendary: Sir Scruffhelm of the Thousand Whiskers

lore.common: Its beard collects a bit of every meal, so it carries yesterday's dinner around as a snack for later.
lore.uncommon: Its bushy eyebrows go up and down like it is reading your thoughts.
lore.rare: Cleared the barn of rats in one morning and lined them up outside, all very surprised.
lore.epic: Sounded the alarm at a suspicious parcel so fiercely that every doorbell in the village started barking back. The postman now announces deliveries by carrier pigeon.
lore.legendary: Sir Scruffhelm guarded the old mill against a rat king for thirteen winters. His eyebrows still twitch whenever someone mentions cheese.

names.legendary: Captain Newflood, Shield of Sailors

lore.common: Shakes its head after drinking and showers the kitchen with affection and slobber.
lore.uncommon: Swims across the lake to greet the ducks. The ducks file a complaint about the waves.
lore.rare: Tows three stranded swimmers to shore and immediately goes back for the lost picnic basket.
lore.epic: Pulled a capsized fishing boat through the storm while the crew clung to its enormous fluffy back. The harbour threw a parade and ran out of towels.
lore.legendary: Newflood guarded the northern coast through one hundred winters, hauling shipwrecked crews from the black surf. Sailors still leave biscuits by the lighthouse for the great shadow in the waves.

names.legendary: Norfolk Nell, Duchess of Burrows

lore.common: Digs a hole precisely the size of itself, then sits inside grinning at the gardener.
lore.uncommon: Wags cheerfully at the vet, the postman and the thunderstorm. Has never met a bad audience.
lore.rare: Squeezes through a rabbit tunnel and emerges with a very indignant rabbit's stolen carrot.
lore.epic: Led a chase through the village hedgerows so daring that every rabbit retired indoors to consider its career.
lore.legendary: Norfolk Nell dug a tunnel beneath the ancient fells and found a lost orchard where the last wild apples grew. Each autumn she brings back one for the smallest child in the village.

names.legendary: Fjordrik, Voice of the Northern Forest

lore.common: Barks at the coat rack because it looks suspiciously like a small moose in disguise.
lore.uncommon: Carries a tiny snowball in the curl of its tail and refuses to explain why.
lore.rare: Keeps a towering moose at bay with one unbroken bark. The moose demands earplugs.
lore.epic: Sounded its call across the mountains so powerfully that every moose in the valley turned to listen. The hunters took the opportunity to go home.
lore.legendary: Fjordrik's howl once guided a lost winter caravan through a blind snowstorm to shelter. The northern mountains still answer his voice when the night turns dangerous.

names.legendary: Norwich Ned, Knight of the Smallest Gate

lore.common: Falls asleep in the laundry basket and wakes up ready to fight a sock.
lore.uncommon: Hears a biscuit wrapper open three houses away. Its ears are practically a second pair of legs.
lore.rare: Clears a barn of troublesome rats, then demands to inspect their abandoned tunnels.
lore.epic: Rode to the market inside a farmer's boot and returned having won the annual cabbage prize. No judge could explain the pawprint on the certificate.
lore.legendary: Norwich Ned stood alone at the gate of a threatened village and barked at an advancing wild boar. The boar fled, and the villagers built him a gate small enough to guard comfortably.

names.legendary: Sir Bobtail, Marshal of the Lost Flock

lore.common: Cannot see past its fringe but greets every lamp post as an old friend.
lore.uncommon: Bounces along the path like a washing basket with exceptionally good news.
lore.rare: Herds scattered children into perfect lines at birthday parties. The parents are considering a permanent contract.
lore.epic: Shook its rain-soaked coat across a whole county fair. Everyone went home wearing woolly-looking puddles and the sheep applauded.
lore.legendary: Guided a thousand sheep through a whiteout by scent alone, despite being unable to see its own paws. The shepherd later discovered it had also herded three snowmen and a confused postbox.

names.legendary: Sir Bracken, Hound of the Nine Rivers

lore.common: Comes home from every walk dripping with river water, even when there is no river nearby.
lore.uncommon: Sings to passing otters so loudly they mistake it for a badly tuned foghorn.
lore.rare: Follows an underwater scent trail that other dogs insist cannot exist.
lore.epic: Let out a bay across the valley and summoned every lost fishing boat back to the same jetty. The harbour master now pays it in biscuits.
lore.legendary: Sir Bracken tracked a missing child along nine rivers and through a flooded marsh. He returned at sunrise with the child, two ducks and an enormous stick.

names.legendary: Mademoiselle Plume, Duchess of Flight

lore.common: Flutters its enormous ears at the slightest breeze and nearly takes off with the washing.
lore.uncommon: Learns a new dance before the music starts. The other dogs ask to see the steps again.
lore.rare: Springs over garden walls without disturbing a single flower, using its ears as perfect little sails.
lore.epic: Danced across the royal ballroom without touching the floor. The orchestra forgot the music and played only applause.
lore.legendary: Mademoiselle Plume carried an injured butterfly through a tempest beneath her feathered ears. The butterflies returned every spring, crowning her with a moving halo of colour.

names.legendary: Emperor Pekin, Keeper of the Silk Throne

lore.common: Waddles to its food bowl as if crossing an enormous ceremonial courtyard.
lore.uncommon: Hides in a coat sleeve and expects the wearer to carry it to dinner.
lore.rare: Stares down a dog ten times its size without blinking. The bigger dog apologises.
lore.epic: Took the imperial throne during an afternoon nap and refused to move for the entire state ceremony. The ministers conducted business around the cushion.
lore.legendary: Emperor Pekin once kept watch over a sleeping royal child while the palace fled a winter storm. His tiny roar held back the wolves until sunrise, and he has demanded silk cushions ever since.

names.legendary: Pemberwick, Herder of Giants

lore.common: Lies in the hallway like a furry loaf of bread. The hallway has filed a complaint.
lore.uncommon: Wags its entire backside because its tail took early retirement.
lore.rare: Herds a dozen sheep by barking at their ankles. The sheep are twice its height and deeply embarrassed.
lore.epic: Led a hundred corgis through the palace on tiny legs. The guards surrendered when the parade stole every royal slipper.
lore.legendary: Pemberwick herded a wandering giant back across the hills by nipping its enormous ankles. The giant now waits at gates like a well-trained sheep.

names.legendary: Lady Pompalina of the Wolf Pack

lore.common: Looks like a walking cushion until bath time reveals a very small dog inside.
lore.uncommon: Barks at the vacuum cleaner until it agrees to leave the room.
lore.rare: Puffs up to twice its size when a bigger animal approaches. The mirror is its only believer.
lore.epic: Shook its fur in the middle of a busy square, blanketing the market in fluffy tumbleweeds. The pigeons built a luxurious nest.
lore.legendary: Lady Pompalina stared down a pack of wolves and led them home in a perfectly orderly procession. They now guard her favourite squeaky toy.

names.legendary: Pugustus, Emperor of the Warm Cushion

lore.common: Snores like a chainsaw in a teacup and refuses to admit it is awake.
lore.uncommon: Gives the vacuum cleaner a furious speech every time it passes the sofa.
lore.rare: Can detect a cheese wrapper opening three rooms away, even in its deepest nap.
lore.epic: Snored so powerfully at the dog show that every ribbon curled into a spiral. The judges declared it Best in Noise.
lore.legendary: Pugustus claimed the palace's only sunlit cushion and held it against forty royal hounds. The royal decree now names it his hereditary throne.

names.legendary: Ruskar, Guardian of the Red Marsh

lore.common: Pads through the swamp looking for a dry patch, then gives up and sits in the mud.
lore.uncommon: Moves so quietly through reeds that the frogs stop croaking just to listen.
lore.rare: Sends a low howl across the marsh to gather a scattered pack before the flood rises.
lore.epic: Led the last wolves through a burning sunset over the wetlands. Their howls silenced the hunters and called the lost pups home.
lore.legendary: Ruskar protected the final red-wolf den when the old forest vanished. Each spring the marsh reeds turn russet for one evening, marking the path to his hidden refuge.

names.legendary: Redbriar, Hound of the Forgotten Trail

lore.common: Follows an interesting smell into a bush and emerges wearing the bush.
lore.uncommon: Has a polished red coat and an opinion on every squirrel in the county.
lore.rare: Tracks a missing child across a rain-washed forest when every human trail has disappeared.
lore.epic: Sang a baying call so loud at the moonlit hunt that every hound in the valley joined in, and the moon appeared to shake.
lore.legendary: Redbriar followed the last trail left by a wandering star through mountains and deep rivers. Hunters still see his copper coat whenever the night sky is clear.

names.legendary: Zolara, Lionheart of the Rust Plains

lore.common: Wears a mohawk of backwards fur and refuses to let anybody flatten it.
lore.uncommon: Patrols the garden with the seriousness of a lion and the appetite of a house dog.
lore.rare: Follows a scent through the dry grass even after the wind blows every trace away.
lore.epic: Kept a pride of curious lions from the village by pacing along its boundary all night. The lions eventually asked for directions elsewhere.
lore.legendary: Zolara stood guard over a shepherd's family as the great grass fires swept the plain. The ridge on her back still points against the wind that saved them.

names.legendary: Rudolf Ironpaw, Keeper of the Purse

lore.common: Leans its full weight into a cuddle. Its owner has accepted life on the floor.
lore.uncommon: Carries the shopping money in a purse around its neck and checks the change with a terrifying stare.
lore.rare: Guards the village gates ferociously until someone calls it a good boy. Then it melts into an enormous puddle.
lore.epic: Defended the butcher's sausages from a gang of hungry foxes while refusing even one taste. The butcher now pays it in belly rubs.
lore.legendary: Rudolf Ironpaw guarded a royal butcher's shop through seven famines without taking a single sausage. When offered a knighthood, he requested a comfortable rug instead.

names.legendary: Bernardo, Bearer of the Last Warmth

lore.common: Lies across the doorway like a furry snowdrift and makes everybody climb over its belly.
lore.uncommon: Carries cocoa in a little barrel, but only serves it once the rescuers compliment its ears.
lore.rare: Finds a lost mitten beneath a mountain of snow, then insists on keeping the mitten as a trophy.
lore.epic: Dug out a buried mountain lodge and carried its entire dinner party to safety, chairs included. The chef refused to leave without the soup.
lore.legendary: Bernardo walked through a blizzard that had swallowed the alpine passes and brought every lost traveller home. His collar bell still rings whenever anyone is missing in the snow.

names.legendary: Saluka, the Wind Between the Dunes

lore.common: Runs the length of the garden at impossible speed, then spends the afternoon claiming to be exhausted.
lore.uncommon: Flicks its elegant ear feathers in the wind like a desert prince inspecting his robes.
lore.rare: Races a gazelle across the dunes, then slows down to let it keep its dignity.
lore.epic: Ran a perfect circle around a sandstorm and tied its winds into a knot. The camels were grateful but demanded their missing hats.
lore.legendary: Saluka has outrun every shadow in the desert except her own. When the moon rises, the dunes remember the delicate prints she left thousands of years ago.

names.legendary: Samoyra, the Smiling Northern Star

lore.common: Sheds enough white fur onto your trousers to give them a fashionable winter coat.
lore.uncommon: Smiles at the grumpiest stranger until they surrender a biscuit and a smile of their own.
lore.rare: Pulls a stranded sled through deep snow while its passengers mistake the trail of fur for fresh snowfall.
lore.epic: Shook out its magnificent coat during a winter parade, filling the entire town square with a sparkling blizzard of dog fluff.
lore.legendary: Samoyra guided a lost polar expedition by smiling so brightly that her white fur shone against the dark. The explorers followed that grin home and forgot to photograph the North Pole.
